<script src="/js/webflow.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script>
  var Webflow = Webflow || [];
  Webflow.push(function() {  
    // unbind webflow form handling
    $(document).off('submit');
    $('#wf-form-Presale-Form').submit(function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const $form = $(this);
      const $submit = $('[type=submit]', $form); // Submit button of form
      const buttonText = $submit.val();
      const buttonWaitingText = $submit.attr('data-wait');
      const formMethod = $form.attr('method');
      const formAction = $form.attr('action');
      const formRedirect = $form.attr('data-redirect');
      const recaptchaResponse = grecaptcha.getResponse();
      if (!recaptchaResponse) {
        alert('Please complete the reCAPTCHA challenge.');
        return;
      }
      const formData = $form.serialize();
      if (buttonWaitingText) {
        $submit.val(buttonWaitingText); 
      }
  		const username = 'BT0PdhySImxd0DoABMIkTMtE';
  		const password = 'kvQGZm8JBs3GSKPw2LNLmdFpMrZtVVf7D7';
  		const auth = btoa(`${username}:${password}`);
      $.ajax(formAction, {
      	headers: {'Authorization': `Basic ${auth}`,
    		},
        data: formData,
        method: formMethod
      })
      .done((res) => {
        // If form redirect setting set, then use this and prevent any other actions
        if (formRedirect) { window.location = formRedirect; return; }
        $form
          .hide()
          .siblings('.w-form-done').show()
          .siblings('.w-form-fail').hide();
      })
      .fail((res) => {
        $form
          .siblings('.w-form-done').hide()
          .siblings('.w-form-fail').show();
      })
      .always(() => {
        // Reset text
        $submit.val(buttonText);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
